title: liquiditybot — trading
description: Account performance and live positions for the liquiditybot paper-trading engine. Complementary to 'control' and 'incidents'.

panels.title: Equity
panels.description: Live account equity (cash + open uPnL).

panels.title: P&L today
panels.description: Realized P&L since UTC midnight.

panels.title: Realized (total)
panels.description: Cumulative realized P&L since inception.

panels.title: Open uPnL
panels.description: Unrealized P&L across open positions.

panels.title: Drawdown
panels.description: Peak-to-now drawdown; 15% is the hard stop.

panels.title: Equity curve
panels.description: Account equity over time.

panels.title: Win rate
panels.description: Rolling win rate (closed trades).

panels.title: Win rate (LCB)
panels.description: Wilson lower bound — the honest floor, not a lucky streak.

panels.title: Profit factor
panels.description: Gross profit / gross loss. >1 is net-positive.

panels.title: Expectancy (R)
panels.description: Average trade in R-multiples (realized ÷ stop-risk).

panels.title: Sharpe
panels.description: Per-trade Sharpe (mean ÷ stdev of trade returns).

panels.title: Sortino
panels.description: Per-trade Sortino (downside deviation only).

panels.title: Expectancy ($)
panels.description: Average $ per closed trade.

panels.title: Payoff ratio
panels.description: Avg win ÷ avg loss.

panels.title: Avg win
panels.description: Mean winning trade.

panels.title: Avg loss
panels.description: Mean losing trade.

panels.title: Trades (window)
panels.description: Closed trades in the rolling window.

panels.title: Net P&L (window)
panels.description: Net realized across the window.

panels.title: Loss streak (now)
panels.description: Consecutive losing trades right now — the per-asset circuit-breaker input.

panels.title: Loss streak (max)
panels.description: Worst losing streak in the window.

panels.title: Open positions
panels.description: Open position count (max 5 concurrent).

panels.title: Gross exposure
panels.description: Gross notional as % of equity vs the 35% portfolio-heat cap.

panels.title: Open risk (to stops)
panels.description: Total $ lost if every open stop filled now.

panels.title: Open uPnL
panels.description: Unrealized P&L, all positions.

panels.title: Open positions (net per instrument)
panels.description: Live book, netted per instrument. Instant query — closed positions drop out.

panels.title: Per-asset performance
panels.description: Per-asset edge — the ranking basis for the coming per-asset circuit breaker.

panels.title: Post-fill mark-out (bps)
panels.description: Mark move vs our fill, per asset and horizon. Negative = adverse selection (we get filled right before price moves against us — 'getting scalped'). Persistent negatives at 5s mean entries are being picked off.

panels.title: Maker fill share
panels.description: Share of fills that rested as maker (earned the spread) vs crossed as taker (paid it). Higher = cheaper execution.

panels.title: Avg slippage
panels.description: Rolling mean signed slippage vs the price we asked (bps). Positive = adverse, negative = price improvement.

panels.title: Worst slippage
panels.description: Worst single-fill slippage in the rolling window (bps).

panels.title: Venue RTT
panels.description: Order-path round-trip latency (EWMA).

panels.title: Venue rejects
panels.description: Orders the venue refused (OM-021). Rising = a submit path problem.

panels.title: Dead-man failures
panels.description: Dead-man refresh failures (OM-050); >=3 escalates.

panels.title: Fees paid (total)
panels.description: Cumulative fees since inception.

panels.title: Maker notional
panels.description: Notional filled passively (spread earned).

panels.title: Taker notional
panels.description: Notional filled crossing (spread paid).

panels.title: Fees vs gross profit
panels.description: Fees as % of gross profit — how much of the edge execution costs eat. Above 100% = trading for the venue, not for you.

panels.title: Signal confidence (per asset)
panels.description: Meta-model p(win) per asset — the continuous conviction line.

panels.title: Signal urgency (per asset)
panels.description: Gated trigger: EXACTLY 0 unless all confirmations align, then 0.30-1.00 scaled by burst/freshness. Spiky-to-zero is the DESIGN — a smooth line here would mean overtrading.

panels.title: Gate pass-rate (24h)
panels.description: Per-gate pass share across assets, last 24h. The LOWEST bar is the gate blocking most entries.

panels.title: Learned gate weights
panels.description: GateStats Wilson-LCB learned weight per gate (1.0 = neutral). Above 1 = predictive of wins, below = drag.

panels.title: Confirmed-rate (24h)
panels.description: Share of time each asset's signal was fully confirmed, last 24h.

panels.title: Manipulation suspicion (per asset)
panels.description: MAX of spoof / imbalance-whiplash / cross-venue divergence. Downsizes entries from 0.6, vetoes at 0.9 (SZ-045).

panels.title: Entry decision codes (PT/SZ)
panels.description: Cumulative entry-decision reason codes: PT-041 edge/cost reject, PT-050 exploration bypass, SZ-045 manip veto, SZ-000 approved… Rising slope = that disposition is firing.

panels.title: Regime (current)
panels.description: Live regime read per asset: macro trend state, volatility band, liquidity band. Instant — stale label-sets drop out.

panels.title: Momentum (per asset)
panels.description: Macro momentum score; sign gates counter-trend entries.

panels.title: Volatility percentile (per asset)
panels.description: Where current vol sits vs history — scales tier targets, trails and stops.

panels.title: Spread (per asset, bps)
panels.description: Live spread cost per asset — the floor every edge must clear.

panels.title: Model Brier vs baseline
panels.description: OUTCOME health: rolling Brier of the DEPLOYED model vs the base-rate baseline on the last judged trades (lower=better). Model ABOVE baseline = worse than a naive guess; the governor kills at baseline+0.03. Absent until >=15 trades judgeable.

panels.title: Promised vs delivered win-rate
panels.description: Calibration in one picture: the model's average promised p(win) vs the realized hit rate and its Wilson lower bound on the same judged trades. Promised far above the LCB = the model is overselling its edge.

panels.title: Governor
panels.description: ML governor kill-switch: OK / DEGRADED (shrunk sizing) / KILLED (prior only). Level 2 auto-requests a retrain.

panels.title: Model in use
panels.description: Whether inference uses the trained model (vs the cold-start prior).

panels.title: Kelly multiplier
panels.description: Governor sizing throttle applied to Kelly (1.0 = full).

panels.title: Prob shrinkage
panels.description: How hard p(win) is pulled toward 0.5 before sizing (higher = less trust in the model).

panels.title: Stop widen
panels.description: Whipsaw governor: stops widened by this factor when stop-outs keep recovering past entry.

panels.title: Calibration gap
panels.description: Mean |promised p - realized rate| across probability bins; the governor degrades past 0.15.

panels.title: Feature drift share
panels.description: Fraction of MARKET features past PSI 0.25 (clock features excluded). 0.30 = the retrain-vote line; transient blips self-heal via auto-retrain.

panels.title: Learning velocity (labels/24h)
panels.description: Training rows added in the last 24h — the model's food supply. Zero for a sustained stretch = learning starved (check exploration + min-ticket flow).

panels.title: Labels by source
panels.description: Cumulative labels: LIVE = real fills (ground truth), CANDIDATE = triple-barrier proxy labels. Live is scarce and precious; candidates keep the model fed between fills.

panels.title: Retrain requested
panels.description: Retrain flag currently raised (drift/decay asked for a refit; auto-retrain services it next slow cycle).

panels.title: Retrain failures
panels.description: Auto-retrain attempts that threw. Rising = stale champion kept.

panels.title: Open candidates
panels.description: Shadow entries awaiting a triple-barrier label.

panels.title: Pending labels
panels.description: Real positions open, feature rows awaiting their close label.

panels.title: Deployed model
panels.description: Current rung on the simplicity ladder (logreg -> gbt -> blend -> mlp). The walk-forward selector must EARN each step up.

panels.title: Loss-budget consumption
panels.description: Fraction of the daily/weekly loss budget consumed. Sizing tapers past 50% spent; 100% = hard zero for new risk (exits always run). Anchored to day/week equity marks.

panels.title: Sizing throttles
panels.description: Current entry-size multipliers: the loss-budget taper and the drawdown throttle (decelerate toward the 15% hard stop). 1.0 = no restriction; falling lines = the rails are actively shrinking new risk.

panels.title: Portfolio heat vs cap
panels.description: Gross open notional as a fraction of equity, vs the heat cap. At the cap, new entries are vetoed (RP-051) — exits are never blocked.

panels.title: Reason codes by family
panels.description: Cumulative reason-code emissions by family — SZ sizer, PT pre-trade, RP risk-protocol, FW firewall, OM orders, ML, TH. A jump in RP = budget/heat exhaustion stopping entries.

panels.title: Firewall rejects/clamps by code
panels.description: Independent last-line screen (15c3-5 style): per-code reject/clamp tallies. Entries reject on breach; exits are clamped, never blocked.

panels.title: Candidate tradability scores
panels.description: Skimmer ranking of the candidate pool (spread cost 40% / book depth 35% / bar activity 25%; thresholds in config). At or above promote_score (0.55) a candidate is eligible for the active universe.

panels.title: Promoted (next boot)
panels.description: Candidates promoted into the universe — active at the next runner restart. Core pairs are permanent; cap keeps the total inside the 12-pair REST-fallback envelope.

panels.title: Candidate pool
panels.description: Pairs the skimmer is watching (<=2 REST calls per evaluation, one candidate per interval — watching is nearly free).

panels.title: Promoted pairs
panels.description: The skimmer's current promotion set (joins trading at the next restart; demotion only stops NEW entries — exits are never touched).
